{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend coat, straight cut, hip length, Charcoal Grey #36454F, heavy woven fabric
Thermal leggings, slim fit, full length, Deep Navy #000080, brushed fleece fabric
Knit sweater crew-neck, relaxed fit, hip length, Cream White #FFFDD0, fine-gauge wool fabric
Ankle boots, pointed toe, mid-calf height, Black #000000, waterproof leather with non-slip tread
Thick winter scarf, wide knit, long drop, Forest Green #228B22, chunky cable-knit fabric
Leather gloves, fitted cut, wrist length, Dark Brown #4E342E, insulated lambskin fabric

This outfit provides essential warmth and protection against the freezing temperatures and heavy snow while walking to work. The waterproof boots with non-slip treads ensure safety on potentially icy, salted sidewalks without sacrificing style. Layering the thermal leggings under a cozy knit keeps you dry and comfortable during the long commute in the cold weather. The neutral color palette creates a polished yet practical look appropriate for arriving at the office after a harsh winter walk."}
